methods.name: Stage-Progression
methods.rationale: Applies typical Growth → next-stage step-up multiplier (1.2x) to $47M total raised proxy.

methods.name: Peer-Median
methods.skip_reason: insufficient narrow peer set in Transportation (found 0 same-stage, 0 adjacent-stage, 0 similar-tier; need ≥3)
methods.rationale: 3 same-sector peers exist in Transportation, but none of the narrow filters (same-stage / adjacent-stage / similar-valuation-tier) yielded ≥3 datapoints. Falling back to all-sector median would be misleading.

data.narrative:
Pivotal, a Growth-stage transportation company founded by Marcus Leng and backed by Page, is the subject of this valuation. The Transportation sector comp universe consists of three private peers (Rivian, The Boring Company, Einride) with no public comparables identified.

Stage-Progression methodology is the applicable triangulation approach. Using Pivotal's $47M total raised as a base proxy and applying a 1.2x step-up multiplier typical for Growth-stage advancement yields an implied valuation of $56M. This method is grounded in observed advancement patterns across Growth financing rounds. Peer-Median triangulation was inapplicable due to insufficient narrow peer data; while three Transportation-sector peers exist, none met the same-stage, adjacent-stage, or similar-tier filters required for meaningful comparison. Relying on all-sector medians would introduce undue noise.

The analysis supports a valuation range of $48M to $64M, with a median point of $56M. This range reflects conservative to moderately optimistic interpretations of Growth-stage step-ups relative to capital deployed. Primary uncertainties stem from the limited peer universe and lack of public Transportation comps to anchor relative valuation. The strength of this conclusion depends on whether the 1.2x multiplier accurately reflects Pivotal's specific unit economics, capital efficiency, and market position relative to Transportation-sector funding patterns. Additional revenue, growth rate, or profitability metrics would materially improve confidence in this range.
